items.question: How do Indian manufacturers find buyers in France?
items.answer: Map French companies whose portfolios match your capability, then contact the sourcing or development team directly. A tablet and capsule maker reached French pharma sourcing and supply chain leads this way and held 18 buyer meetings with 6 requests for quotation. A carton maker reaching cosmetics brands booked 18 meetings.

items.question: Should outreach to French buyers be in French?
items.answer: Where you can, yes. Our pharma contract manufacturing campaign wrote to French sourcing teams in both French and English and received 36 positive replies. Many French procurement teams work in English, but a message in their own language shows the effort and makes replying easier for anyone less comfortable writing in English.

items.question: Is B2B cold email allowed in France?
items.answer: Yes, within GDPR. France's regulator, the CNIL, accepts B2B email prospecting without prior consent when the message relates to the recipient's job, the recipient is told how their data is used and they can opt out easily. This is general information, not legal advice, so confirm specifics with counsel.

items.question: Can outbound replace trade shows for European buyers?
items.answer: It works best alongside them. Exhibitions give you a few days a year with buyers; outbound keeps conversations going in between and reaches buyers who don't attend. Our French manufacturer campaigns turned outreach into quotation and sample requests without waiting for the next show. Campaigns usually go live about 18 days after onboarding.
